settings.heading: What makes Smilie's Boost Teeth Whitening Kit different?

settings.text: The Smilie Boost Whitening Kit is designed with the same professional-grade ingredients dentists use, but at a lower and safer concentration - so you get effective whitening without harshness. What truly sets it apart is the added Potassium Nitrate, a proven ingredient that helps calm and protect sensitive teeth while you whiten. This means you don’t just get a brighter smile - you get it comfortably, without the pain that many other whitening kits can cause.

settings.heading: Are Smilie products safe to use?

settings.text: Yes. Every product is dentist-developed and dermatologist-considered. Our whitening formula is sensitivity-free by design, and our beauty devices are built to professional standards for safe at-home use.

settings.heading: I have sensitive teeth or skin - can I still use Smilie?

settings.text: Sensitivity is something we take seriously. Our whitening formulations are specifically designed to minimise sensitivity while still delivering real results, and our devices are built with adjustable settings so you can work at your own pace. That said, if you have a specific condition or concern, please reach out to our team.
